name: get_events
description: List events, going back up to 30 days; each event data is rendered according to Stripe API version at its creation time. (GET /v1/events)

type.description: A string containing a specific event name. The list will be filtered to include only events with a matching event property.

limit.description: A limit on the number of objects to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 100, and the default is 30.
